title: Large language model for Bible sentiment analysis: Sermon on the Mount

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing sentiment polarity (AFINN) and multi-label sentiment classification (S-BERT) across five different English Bible translations to observe emotional and stylistic divergences caused by translators' cultural, political, and temporal contexts.

Evaluating the misclassification of biblical metaphors (e.g., incorrectly labeling serious passages as 'joking') caused by domain mismatch, as the underlying sentiment model was fine-tuned on modern COVID-19 Twitter data.
